description: What is this NDC code, or what products exist for this medicine name? Looks up US medicine products in the FDA National Drug Code Directory by brand or generic name or by NDC (product 0573-0169, package 0573-0169-02, or the 11-digit billing form 00573-0169-02 / 00573016902): labeller, active ingredients and strengths, dosage form, route, OTC or prescription, approval reference and pack sizes. For pharmacy, billing and supply-chain work. Source: U.S. FDA openFDA NDC Directory. US-listed products only; name searches return finished medicines (not bulk ingredients), and delisted products are missing. (cost: 1 credit)

limit.description: integer, optional, maximum products for a name search, 1-20, default 5

name.description: string, brand or generic name (e.g. Advil); give this or ndc

ndc.description: string, NDC: product with hyphens (0573-0169), package with hyphens (0573-0169-02), or a 10- or 11-digit package code with or without hyphens (00573-0169-02, 00573016902); give this or name

name: fda_ndc_lookup
